links.outcome: Accuracy of clinical NLI against benchmark ground truth, agentic framework versus direct prompting
links.effect: CARENLI improves mean accuracy from about 23% with direct prompting to about 57%, a gain of roughly 34 points across four backbone models.
links.quote: Across four contemporary backbone models, CARENLI improves mean accuracy from about 23% with direct prompting to about 57%, a gain of roughly 34 points, with the largest benefits on structurally demanding reasoning types.

unlisted_practices: Routing clinical inference inputs to reasoning-family-specific solvers (compartmentalised agentic reasoning) with explicit verification and targeted refinement

screen.reason: Evaluates a proposed agentic framework (CARENLI) with compartmentalised reasoning and verification against direct prompting on a clinical NLI benchmark dataset.
